firm_data.firm_description: Vecchione, Vecchione & Cano, LLP is a New York-based law firm specializing in workers' compensation cases. They represent employers, carriers, and third-party administrators.
notable_facts: The firm has decades of experience in litigating Workers’ Compensation cases.
Michael F. Vecchione successfully argued the Zamora case in front of the Court of Appeals, saving clients significant sums of money.
Gina Marie Cano was a Keynote Speaker at the New York State Self Insured Conference in 2017.

email.subject: AI for workers' compensation practices like yours
email.body:
Hi Michael,

With decades of experience litigating workers' compensation cases for employers, carriers, and third-party administrators, Vecchione, Vecchione & Cano operates in one of the most document-intensive practice areas in law. The complexity you handle daily is exactly what we built for.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform created for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now meeting regional firms to show how ex-lawyers like us are helping practices compete with larger competitors.

Worth 20 minutes to explore if Lucio fits your workflow?

Vasu
Lucio
